mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the easing cycle, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased supply-side activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with increased supply-side activity.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% each over the previous 3 months signals increased economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and PAYEMS does not correlate with increased economic demand.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market with increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases > 1% in 3 months
regime_hint: tightening labor market with increased economic activity
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the previous 6 months signals an accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 6 months
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not correlate with accommodative policy and growth.
